verdict.rationale: Skyvern's own docs repeatedly say its agent downloads files from the sites it operates, such as logging into vendor portals and downloading invoice PDFs (skyvern-docs-31, skyvern-docs-15, skyvern-docs-47, skyvern-docs-48). There is no explicit evidence of file upload, and no documented way to retrieve downloaded files after a run. The run artifacts in skyvern-docs-11 are recordings, screenshots and logs, not the downloaded files, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: documented file-upload capability, documented API or storage for retrieving downloaded files after a run, technical docs beyond marketing mentions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
